references.text: describes women who followed Jesus from Galilee to serve him, which mirrors the description in Mark 15:41 of the women who followed and served Jesus.
mentions some specific women who followed Jesus and served him with their own resources, providing context for the service of the women mentioned in Mark 15:41.
mentions all of Jesus' acquaintances who stood at a distance, including the women who had followed him from Galilee, which corresponds to the description in Mark 15:41.
